loop.top3_series_pattern: strong trend, strong seasonality, mixed predictability, unstable model ranking across windows
loop.top3_why: The weighted:pooled_meta_model strategy (B) offers a robust, data‑driven weighting that balances the strong seasonal signal and long‑run trend while mitigating the instability in model rankings. Its per‑window errors are consistently low (≈0.66–0.68) and it avoids the high variance seen in the DBA approach, which, despite a lower mean score, shows a large spike in the third window. The weighted scheme also benefits from a meta‑model trained on many series, providing a more generalizable weighting than a simple mean.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A (plain mean) is slightly less stable on the second window and offers no adaptive weighting, making it more vulnerable to the unstable ranking. Candidate C (DBA) has the best overall score but its per‑window spread (0.60–0.74) indicates overfitting to specific windows; the high error in the last window suggests it may not generalize well to the blind test. Therefore, B is the safest choice for this series.
